settings.heading: Frequently asked questions
settings.subtext: Shipping, returns, products, payment: all the answers to your questions.

settings.question: What are the shipping times and costs?
settings.answer: Your order is prepared within 24 hours and delivered in 2 to 4 business days within the continental US. Free shipping on orders over $50; below that, a flat $4.90 fee applies.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship to Canada, the UK, and the EU. Delivery times range from 4 to 8 business days depending on the destination.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: As soon as your order ships, you'll receive an email with a real-time tracking link. Be sure to check your spam folder.

settings.question: Are your products suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Yes. Our formulas are dermatologist-tested and developed at a skin-friendly pH. The full INCI ingredient list is on every product page.

settings.question: Are your products tested on animals?
settings.answer: Never. All our formulas are cruelty-free, and most are vegan (noted on each product page).

settings.question: How does the satisfaction guarantee work?
settings.answer: You have 30 days after delivery to change your mind. Contact us with your order number: we'll arrange the return and refund you within 5 days of receiving it.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: Credit card (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. All transactions are encrypted and secure.

settings.question: How do I use my promo code?
settings.answer: Enter your code in the dedicated field at checkout. Only one code can be used per order.

settings.heading: Didn't find your answer?
settings.text: Our team is happy to help — we respond within 24 business hours.
